program.title: Minor Program in Robotics
uncertain: total_required_credits (18.0) is the stated minimum total for the minor (PDF: 'complete a minimum total of 18 credits').
ENGG 3960-3962 and ENGG 4950 have variable credits 1-4 (taken as 3 for the lower-bound total); exact courses covered by the 'ENGG3960-3962' range are not individually enumerated in the PDF.

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: Robotics Electives: 18 credits from the specified elective list, of which at least 7 credits must be taken from Group A Electives and include at least 1 COMP course; at least 2 courses from Group B; and at least 1 course from Group C. The group for each course is given in 'areas'. Subject to approval, a PG course (e.g. ELEC 5660, COMP 5421) may substitute a Group B elective. ENGG 4950F and ENGG 4950T may not count towards Group C.
